formal_statement: ∀ (n m : ℕ) (k : Fin m → ℕ) (S : Fin m → Finset (Fin n)) (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) (o : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin m → ℕ), (∀ i j : Fin m, i ≠ j → (S i ∩ S j).card ≤ 1) → (∀ i : Fin m, 2 ≤ (S i).card) → (∀ g ∈ C.gates, (g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and ∨ g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or) ∧ g.inputs.length = 2) → PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack n C → (∀ (i : Fin m) (p : Fin n), (C.wires (List.ofFn (fun q : Fin n => decide (q = p)))).getD (o i) false = true ↔ p ∈ S i) → (∀ (i : Fin m) (x : Fin n → Bool), (Finset.univ.filter (fun q : Fin n => x q = true)).card ≤ k i → (∀ q ∈ S i, x q = false) → (C.wires (List.ofFn x)).getD (o i) false = false) → (∀ i : Fin m, c i ≤ k i) → (∀ i : Fin m, c i + 1 ≤ (S i).card) → ∑ i : Fin m, c i ≤ C.size
plain_statement: Sets S_i (i < m) of the n inputs, each of at least 2 elements, any two sharing at most one. C: AND and OR gates, each reading exactly two earlier wires. Output o_i is true at a single input p exactly when p is in S_i, and false at every input with at most k_i true inputs and none in S_i; the level k_i may differ per output. If c_i <= k_i and c_i <= |S_i| - 1 for each i, then the sum of the c_i is at most the number of gates of C.
title: Graded Boolean-sums count: fan-in-two AND/OR circuits whose outputs are sound each at its own level k_i need at least the sum of the c_i <= k_i gates
